welcome.title: Sign in for registered users
welcome.description: :name is an office platform with AI agents for daily work — notes, assistance and communication. Access is limited to registered users. For access or questions, contact us at

password.hint: Minimum :min characters, at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one digit, and one special character.
password.label: Password
password.leave_blank: Leave blank if you are not changing it
password.generated_description: We generated a new password for :user. Save it and share it securely with the user after creating the profile.

two_factor.description: When 2FA is enabled, the QR code, manual key, and recovery codes are emailed to :email. If that is not possible, instructions are sent to your email so you can pass them to the user. The user sets up the app on their phone and then signs in with a 6-digit code on every login.
two_factor.email_not_sent_description: :reason Pass the details below to the user through another channel (phone, messenger, etc.) so they can set up 2FA in their app.
two_factor.disabled_message: Two-factor authentication was disabled for this user.
two_factor.manual_delivery_message: Two-factor authentication is enabled, but the email was not sent. Pass the details to the user manually.
two_factor.sent_to_creator_message: Failed to send to :userEmail. Instructions were sent to your email: :sentTo. Pass them to the user.
two_factor.not_enabled: Two-factor authentication is not enabled for this user.
two_factor.user_missing_email: The user does not have an email address.
two_factor.user_invalid_email: The user's email address is not valid.
two_factor.email_send_failed: The email could not be sent automatically.

mail.title: 2FA setup
mail.heading: Two-factor authentication
mail.subject_admin: 2FA setup for :name – forward to the user
mail.greeting_admin: Hello, :initiatorName! You enabled two-factor authentication (2FA) for user :userName, but we could not send the instructions to their email (:userEmail). Please pass the details below to the user so they can set up 2FA in their app.
mail.greeting_admin_no_email: Hello, :initiatorName! You enabled two-factor authentication (2FA) for user :userName, but we could not send the instructions to their email. Please pass the details below to the user so they can set up 2FA in their app.
mail.greeting_user: Hello, :userName! An administrator enabled two-factor authentication (2FA) for your account in :app.
mail.how_to_title: How to set up the app
mail.step_install: Install an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy, or another TOTP app).
mail.step_add: Add a new account by scanning the QR code below or by entering the key manually.
mail.step_save: Store the recovery codes in a safe place.
mail.step_login: On your next sign-in to the control panel you will be asked to enter a 6-digit code from the app.
mail.manual_key_intro: If you cannot scan the QR code, enter this key manually:
mail.recovery_description: Use these codes if you lose access to your app. Each code can be used only once.
mail.login_intro: After setting up the app, you can sign in to the control panel at:
mail.footer: If you did not expect this email, contact the system administrator.
